profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Front End Software Engineer dedicated to creating user-focused experiences. Always eager to learn, my thirst for knowledge is as strong as my adoration for puppies. Have excelled in both client-facing and internal roles and have thrived and enjoyed working in various industries.

Personal Website
gabyhernan.com

positions.title: Front End  Developer
positions.description:
- Contributed on designs with UX/UI designers and created the front end facing part of two beta web apps that involved social media APis (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Youtube) 
- Maintained servers and hosting for clients in AWS and GoDaddy.
- Developed several Wordpress websites. 
- Worked on e-commerce sites using Shopify and Lightspeed.
- Created email marketing templates and was in charge of sending out email newsletters for several clients such as Way of Wade.

positions.title: Web Development Immersive | Web Developer
positions.description:
Intense, experienced-based work in some of the most important languages today. 

I came into GA to submerge myself into coding. In this course, I learned the value pair programming adds to a group project and how coding teaches you perseverance and grit. GA’s environment of constant creation and collaboration has been a strong base and I am eager to continue this road of learning.

positions.title: Client Advisor
positions.description:
-Interpersonal skills - Meeting ,developing and maintaining client relationships with a diverse group of individuals. 
-Smaller store where you are opening and closing by yourself. Must be proactive and organized in order to meet all the operational processes of the store which includes, receiving, assembling, store transfers,maintaining visual merchandising and shipping all while cultivating excellent client relationships.
- Have successfully managed to exceed my highly competitive sales goals through the use of tactful clienteling abilities and grit.

positions.title: Fashion Buyer / Digital Marketing
positions.description:
-Assisted in development of the overall brand concept and messaging.
- In charge of all the merchandise buying process and negotiation .
- Actively involved in the creative concepts of look books, directed photo shoots and styled them.
- Teamed up with graphic designer & social media manager on content strategy and digital marketing campaigns

positions.title: Fashion Intern
positions.description: Assisted well known and respected stylist Danny Santiago in fashion shows such as the Mercedes Benz Swim Week, editorials such as Vogue Italy , commercials such as Telemundo Holiday commercial, & corporate events for Coca-Cola.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Sales associate inside of Bloomingdale retail space. Customer clienteling experience. Visual merchandising as well as restocking.

projects.title: tripED
projects.description:
Streamlines the tedious process of booking a school field trip for teachers & locations.

- Skills: Ruby, Bcrypt. Redis, OAuth, JQuery, Materialize
-A Ruby on Rails, CRUD Heroku Deployed Web App that allows users to sign up & log in with Google OAuth. Users can book trips through POST & GET data from server-side back-end
Postgres SQL Database.
- Users can get transit directions from Google Maps, Places API
